About Detail
A collection of interface details
Detail collects the extra considerations, the cares, the One More Thing that separates software that works from software that feels
right
.
Detail honor craftsmanship and believe details
are
the product.
Detail starts from 2025 by
Rene Wang
, a design engineer who previously worked on Lark and TikTok at ByteDance, then
LobeHub
.
Why Now
AI can generate a functional interface in seconds. The barrier to creating something that
works
has never been lower. But there's a difference between something that works and something that feels
right
. That difference lives entirely in the details.
Did you see the difference?
00:00
00:00
1×
Did you see the difference?
AI can't feel when a button's resistance is just right. Humans can.
"
In a world of scarcity, we treasure tools.
In a world of abundance, we treasure taste.
— Anu Atluru, Taste is Eating Silicon Valley
"
As more of the world becomes automated, the people who understand these details are the ones who'll build products people actually love.
Curation
Not every detail makes it here. If removing a detail breaks the product, it's not a detail, it's a necessity. A detail is a consideration nobody had to make, chosen anyway because it makes things better.
The
Resource
vault follows the same standard: only evergreen picks, nothing timely. It reshuffles monthly, so if something catches you, bookmark it right then.

Quickly access Detail in Figma.
